Priya Nair: quick sync: partners asked for a single handoff doc for marketplace + SI + press. we should map SKUs to our internal model ids and note any embargo exceptions per region.
Carlos Mendes: agree. vendor asks: 48h embargo min, prefer 72h. vendors also want the SKU/press slug for embargo copy.
Owen Park: timeline suggestion: H100/H200 listed June 9-11 window, B200 in same wave if inventory confirmed, MI300 targeted June 23-25, Gaudi remains partner-controlled (private preview first).
Yuki Tanaka: inventory note 1: AMD flagged a potential MI300 shipment delay to late June. if that holds we should be ready to do a split GA.
Priya Nair: action: create SKU mapping + delta table for press ops. @Carlos can you lead vendor parity?
Carlos Mendes: yes, i'll compile vendor SKUs and map to Redwood model ids. will also mark region exclusions (CN/KR restrictions).
Owen Park: marketplace CI will need a CSV of: vendor_sku, redwood_model_id, marketplace_sku, region, driver_image_tag. please include kernel version where relevant.
Yuki Tanaka: SI readiness checklist items:
- certified image tags + docker digest
- kernel/driver pair
- validated dockerfile run command
- simple perf smoke script (1k tokens, 2 concurrent requests)
- rollback contact info
Noor Ali: marketing: will draft embargo copy, but need a fallback clause allowing staggered listings by SKU/region. also confirm whether partners require embargoed collateral prior to our announcement.
Priya Nair: i recommend wording: "Listings may be staggered by SKU and region pending partner supply and certifications." ok?
Noor Ali: LGTM. we'll keep headline flexible. also ask legal if any partner NDA language required to include.
Carlos Mendes: doing vendor outreach now: pinged nvidia-sales, amd-ecosys, and gaudi-ps. will update sheet by EOD tomorrow.
ReleaseBot: reminder set for 2026-06-08 09:00 PT to validate SKU sheet before embargo release (creator: Carlos Mendes)
Owen Park: CI risk: marketplace pipeline needs tags by 2026-06-02 or we have to push the H100 wave by +1 week.
Yuki Tanaka: SI runbook draft by 2026-06-04. include smoke test commands.
Priya Nair: consolidated action list:
- Carlos: vendor SKU parity + sheet by 2026-06-01 EOD
- Owen: CI mapping + test vectors by 2026-06-02
- Yuki: SI runbook draft by 2026-06-04
- Noor: embargo copy draft after SKU sheet
Priya Nair: i'll post a single handoff doc linking SKU sheet + SI runbook and ping comms. thanks all :rocket:
